en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a grand Baroque/Neoclassical episcopal residence with a formal garden in the foreground. A large statue of a robed figure stands on a high pedestal in front of the building, and there is also an obelisk-like monument to the right. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and sit on benches. Decorative handwritten script covers the lower margin. Printed text near the bottom right reads "Püspöki Rezidenczia," and the word "Pécs" appears in the handwriting at the bottom left.
